pay_control._finding: Neither exposure-type contrast survives the pay control. Between 1.0 and 11.4 percent of the raw gap remains at the weaker end, and the SIPP Eloundou GPT cap contrast reverses sign. Report a PAY mechanism with an exposure-type CORRELATE.

federal_share_with_second_round_min.note: the second round raises the total and LOWERS the federal share

case_B_over_A_min.note: fiscal loss under case B over case A

break_even_tau_k_case_A_min.note: tau_l * (1 - R), at the highest R on the grid

break_even_tau_k_case_A_max.note: tau_l * (1 - R) at R = 0, so it equals tau_l exactly. BOUND: cannot exceed tau_l + g

break_even_tau_k_case_B_min.note: tau_l * ((1 - R) * D + (W / Y) * dC) / (D - dC)

break_even_tau_k_case_B_max.note: BOUND: may exceed tau_l, because the base shrinks as the loss grows, but not 1

cases._definition_case_B: tau_l * ((1 - R) * D + (W / Y) * dC) / (D - dC), where D is the gross displaced wage bill and dC the demand shortfall
cases._bounds: 0 <= case A <= tau_l + g; 0 <= either case <= 1; case B >= case A; D - dC > 0
cases._withdrawn_round1: the round-one values 0.213835 to 0.378371 (case A) and 0.560866 to 0.860022 (case B) are WITHDRAWN. They divided a loss that already nets out tau_k by a surplus built on a different wage bill total, and the case A maximum broke the tau_l + g bound, which is how the replicator caught it
cases._rule: every fiscal figure published before the closing session is a CASE A figure; case B is the internally consistent one whenever the second-round module is quoted

baseline_20y_emerging_market.note: NO DISPLACEMENT, r 9 percent against g 3

debt._withdrawn: A91's 389 percent at a 10 percent dose is WITHDRAWN as a statement about automation: it is almost entirely the no-displacement baseline compounding at r above g

labour_backing._definition: FIRST-ROUND servicing only. Business-revenue-serviced classes are ZERO BY RULE. Social insurance is a memo item OUTSIDE the ratio. All values are for the latest complete Z.1 year, 2025. Every quantity is PROVISIONAL and none has ever been checked from outside.

labour_backed_bn.note: sum of level x backing share

direct_labour_backing_ratio.note: BOUND: in [0,1], and between the smallest and largest class backing share

indirect_backing_of_business_revenue.note: B2, (PCE/GDP) x (WASCUR/PI). BOUND: below each of its two components. NEVER blended into the direct ratio

combined_first_and_second_round_ratio.note: B2, NOT the headline. BOUND: at or above the direct ratio

sovereign_share_held_or_guaranteed.note: federal government as HOLDER or GUARANTOR. Agency and GSE pools, the GSEs and the central bank count as federal

sovereign_share_obligor.note: federal government as OBLIGOR, that is Treasury debt serviced from labour-linked receipts

sovereign_share_union.note: BOUND: in [0,1] and at or above each leg. THE HEADLINE HOLDER RESULT. Compare with the 75.9 to 91.6 percent federal share of first-round losses

one_step_rule_move_pct.note: the single largest judgement call, by a factor of seven over the next one

quintile_labour_backed_per_wage_dollar_Q.note: B5. BOUND: quintile shares sum to 1

two_sided_bet._definition: B11 and B12. The AI EQUITY SCALE is a SCENARIO parameter, swept over 0.10, 0.20, 0.30 of US nonfinancial corporate equity. The central case is 0.20. AI DEBT and bank commitments are sourced. Off-balance-sheet financing is NOT sourced, so every failure-state figure is a LOWER BOUND.

federal_share_of_ai_leg_central.note: BOUND: holder shares sum to 1 within the leg

federal_share_of_wage_leg_union.note: the same quantity as above, restated

ai_onbalancesheet_debt_bn.note: SEC XBRL, long term debt plus finance leases, 9 named filers

debt_financed_share_of_ai_capex.note: capex in excess of operating cash flow, over capex, across the named filers. BOUND: in [0,1]. THE FAILURE-STATE INDICATOR

aggregate_self_funding_ratio.note: operating cash flow over capex. Above 1 is the 2000 structure, below 1 the 2008 structure

share_of_federal_wage_loss_hedged_at_ope.note: 10 percent dose, case A, GROSS of capital tax. The published fiscal loss is already NET of tax at the operative rate, so the gross basis is required or the tax is counted twice
